description_en: Queries the valid applications of the current account by paging based on conditions such as the application ID, name, type, and associated product
description_zh: 按应用标识、名称、类型和所属产品等条件分页查询当前账号的有效应用
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center list-app --app-id 'app-bp1example****' --app-name '业务管理' --app-type USER_APP --origin-app-type WEB_BASE --sub-app-type SAAS --os-type Windows --biz-type 1 --product-type CloudApp --biz-type-list 1 --product-type-list CloudApp --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListApp
